View Dean's List About Academics At High Point University you will receive a extraordinary education in an inspiring environment with caring people. Be ready for transformation at The Premier Life Skills University. At HPU you will develop life skills, gain practical, experiential learning, and expand your knowledge through academic excellence. High Point University offers 66 undergraduate majors and 68 undergraduate minors plus a series of graduate programs leading the way in academic innovation. Explore our academic programs and join the family today. You were born to be extraordinary!
